result.title: GOPR-CAD: Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning for CAD Generation
result.summary: Generating accurate CAD models requires substantial engineering expertise and careful control of geometry, topology, and mechanical constraints. Text-to-CAD aims to simplify this process, but current LLM-based methods often generate CAD programs directly. Language models remain unreliable when producing long code while coordinating coupled geometric, topological, and dimensional constraints. Consequently, executable programs may still produce structurally incorrect models, which execution rate and rendered appearance may fail to reveal. To address these limitations, we propose GOPR-CAD, an agentic Text-to-CAD pipeline based on Graph-of-Operations Progressive Reasoning. A language model acts as a decision agent over encapsulated CAD operations and progressively constructs an executable operation graph, which a deterministic compiler converts into the final CAD model. This separation requires no additional training and supports different language models. To evaluate structural fidelity, we construct MHCAD, a benchmark of 300 standard mechanical part requirements derived from Machinery's Handbook. Their explicit structures enable reference-free STEP/B-rep evaluation. GOPR-CAD achieves 82.7% Structural Yield on MHCAD, and 87.2% Structural Yield on an external CADPrompt subset.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GOPR-CAD：让语言模型作为决策代理，在封装好的 CAD 操作上逐步构建可执行的操作图，再由确定性编译器转为最终 CAD 模型；同时构建 MHCAD 基准，用 STEP/B-rep 做免参考的结构保真评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式操作图＋确定性编译」把长程生成改写为结构化状态的逐步更新与分步核验，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与外部结构化工作区的分工、以及每步状态如何验证提供可核查线索，但不涉及视觉推理本身。
